http/cache_control#

Cache-Control directives (RFC 9111 §5.2).

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let control = CacheControl(response::Head::headers);
control.present("no-store");
control.seconds("max-age");                    // InvalidCacheControl unless one argument

Description#

Cache-Control directives (RFC 9111 §5.2).

Directive names are case-insensitive. Fields are bounded (8192 bytes and 128 directives by default).
